findings.title: Company selection retains the previous company page and modal state
findings.trigger: A user with two active fleets switches A to B without leaving the current company page.
findings.observed: Actual compiled Overview/useAsync loaded once and continued displaying org-a metrics after user.organizationId became org-b. CompanyScreen Page key used pageKey/revision only; modal key used modal only. New requests use current B signed tokens.
findings.expected: Remount or explicitly revalidate all tenant-specific pages, choices, pending actions and modals on organizationId changes; never show A records beneath B workspace identity.
findings.introduced: The new in-place company context switch exposes existing page state not keyed to tenant.
findings.disposition: Root has since added CompanyShell main key=organizationId. Corrected React reconciliation/browser behavior and final tests are not yet independently rechecked; remain pending at freeze.

findings.title: Nonunique company display names share an uncertain allocation request
findings.trigger: A pending allocation from A is reopened in B where both organizations have the same display name and recipient is an active member of both.
findings.observed: Actual compiled allocation component restored frozen org-a payload from company-allocation:owner:Same Fleet and submitted the same request key under org-b. Server organization-scoped idempotency treats this as a distinct B money movement.
findings.expected: Use organizationId in storage key and persisted payload; reject a restored request or a submission when its organization differs from the signed context.
findings.disposition: Root has since changed storage key/pending payload to organizationId and added API expected-organization409 checking. Corrected behavior and fixture revision are pending independent recheck; artifact records original reproduced defect.

findings.title: Old-password MFA disable can commit after password reset revokes the session
findings.trigger: Authenticated disable attaches the old user/session before reset, verifies old password, and waits to update behind a concurrent password reset.
findings.observed: Isolated real HTTP/PG probe queued reset first behind an account row lock, then disable. Reset returned200, stored replacement password and revoked all sessions; old-password disable still returned200 and stored two_factor_enabled=false afterward.
findings.expected: Revalidate the current account credential, active authenticated session and pending-recovery state while holding the account lock, then atomically disable MFA.
findings.introduced: Pre-existing adjacent disable path, uncovered by credential/reset concurrency review.
findings.disposition: Unfixed at freeze; root is assigning focused AUTH03 correction.

findings.title: Concurrent wrong password logins lose the durable lockout count
findings.trigger: Five simultaneous wrong-password login requests read the same account state before writing failed_login_attempts.
findings.observed: Isolated real HTTP/PG probe returned401 for all five, but persisted only two failed attempts and locked_until=NULL. Assignment from stale user.failed_login_attempts overwrites intervening increments.
findings.expected: Increment the current database counter atomically and derive lockout from the committed count; avoid stale password failures modifying a changed credential revision.
findings.introduced: Pre-existing adjacent login path, uncovered by review of modified login concurrency safeguards.
findings.disposition: Unfixed at freeze; root is assigning focused AUTH03 correction.

findings.title: Pending MFA completion restores old client session after logout or account replacement
findings.trigger: MFA completion is pending when logout clears proof and session, or a newer account login replaces them.
findings.observed: Actual compiled service probe cleared pending proof/tokens/user through authApi.logout, resolved the older successful MFA response, then observed old-user access/refresh tokens and persisted session restored. MFA UI also sets user/navigates unconditionally after success.
findings.expected: Bind auth completion to an unchanged client session generation and exact pending proof; reject obsolete completions before writing tokens, user state or redirect.
findings.disposition: Unfixed at freeze; root is assigning focused AUTH03 correction. Related password-login/AuthProvider generation paths should use the same enforced boundary.

findings.title: Overlapping silent refresh cancels the response it intends to preserve
findings.trigger: refresh() is called again with unchanged inputs while a silent request is pending.
findings.observed: Changed silentNonce runs prior cleanup(active=false), then the next effect returns because inFlight is set. The earlier successful response is ignored. Compiled hook probe retained old records with status=success,error=null and no replacement request.
findings.expected: Drop an overlapping same-input trigger without invalidating the current response; still invalidate on dependency/reload/unmount changes.
findings.introduced: Pre-existing adjacent behavior in the modified shared hook.
findings.disposition: Unfixed at freeze; root plans focused hook fix.

findings.title: Accepted separator-free backup code is sent in a form the server cannot match
findings.trigger: User types A1B2C3D4 instead of generated A1B2-C3D4.
findings.observed: UI optional-hyphen regular expression accepts it, but submission only uppercases. Server hashes exact text and stores hyphenated generated codes, so it rejects and spends a challenge attempt.
findings.expected: Normalize accepted separator-free values to generated XXXX-XXXX representation, or require the separator with a clear validation message.
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed only; no additional HTTP probe. Existing positive backup test covers lowercase/space normalization with separator.
findings.disposition: Unfixed at freeze; root plans backup-format normalization.

findings.title: Provider password change requires reauthentication while UI promises continued sign-in
findings.trigger: Successful password change for a Supabase-managed account.
findings.observed: Provider=true invalidation and finalization revoke all sessions; success response is only ok, old client tokens persist, and modal says You will stay signed in on this device. Closing succeeds until subsequent API calls reject the revoked session.
findings.expected: Expose reauthenticationRequired and explicitly clear/redirect provider sessions on success, with accurate copy; preserve intended local-credential session policy.
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed changed contract; focused provider tests exercise revision/revocation/recovery at fake fetch boundary. No live Supabase call.
findings.disposition: Unfixed at freeze; root is assigning focused AUTH03 correction.
